description: This file defines a React functional component 'RoleCard' for rendering interactive role information cards in a UI, alongside a skeleton placeholder component. It manages hover and selection states, and includes UI styling, animations, and event handlers. The component is used within a Next.js project with Tailwind CSS and custom utility functions.

methods.name: RoleCard
methods.description: React component for displaying a role card with interactive hover, selection, and expandable details.

methods.name: SkeletonCard
methods.description: Component presenting a skeleton placeholder for the role card during loading states.
